title: Sampling Pfaffian point processes and the symplectic Arnoldi method
summary: We present an exact sampling algorithm for Pfaffian point processes based on a skew-symmetric analogue of the Cholesky factorization. This algorithm enables efficient sampling of a wide range of statistics arising in random matrix theory and combinatorics. For instance, we can sample eigenvalues of the orthogonal and symplectic ensembles ($β= 1,4$). In addition, we introduce a symplectic Arnoldi method for computing skew-orthogonal polynomials associated with a general weight function.
